title: scrophularia variegata var. rupestris
intro: Scrophularia variegata var. rupestris, commonly known as Mountain figwort, is a species of flowering plant in the figwort family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving respiratory conditions, and supporting immune function. The therapeutic actions of Mountain figwort include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may be attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and iridoids. These compounds may also contribute to its ability to protect against oxidative stress and modulate the immune response.
